# uzc_vm_autoscale_policy (Resource)

Manages a scale-up policy on a UzCloud VM Autoscale group (POST/PUT/DELETE /autoscale/{autoscale}/policies). The resource ID is "{autoscale}/{policy_id}".

TODO(api): the spec exposes no GET/list for a single policy, so this resource's Read cannot detect drift and simply trusts state; verify the create/update response actually carries the policy id assumed here against a live account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# TODO(api): the spec exposes no GET/list for a single policy, so this
# resource cannot be imported and its Read cannot detect drift.
resource "uzc_vm_autoscale_policy" "example" {
  autoscale  = uzc_vm_autoscale.example.slug
  name       = "scale-up-on-cpu"
  duration   = 60
  quiet_time = 60

  conditions = [
    {
      counter       = "29b518ca-8d64-11ef-8ce4-000c298fabeb"
      counter_id    = "29b518ca-8d64-11ef-8ce4-000c298fabeb"
      operator      = "GT"
      threshold     = 80
      counter_label = "VM CPU - average percentage"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `autoscale` (String) Slug of the uzc_vm_autoscale group to attach the policy to.
- `conditions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions))
- `duration` (Number) Seconds.
- `name` (String)
- `quiet_time` (Number) Seconds.

### Optional

- `updated_policy_duration` (Number)
- `updated_policy_name` (String)
- `updated_policy_quiet_time` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) "{autoscale}/{policy_id}". Used for import.
- `policy_id` (String) Server-assigned policy id.

<a id="nestedatt--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions`

Required:

- `counter` (String) Counter UUID.
- `counter_id` (String)
- `operator` (String) e.g. "GT", "LT".
- `threshold` (Number)

Optional:

- `counter_label` (String) e.g. "VM CPU - average percentage".
